concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-payment-methods-upi-upi-autopay-api-only]] — 2026-09-15 UPI Autopay API-only mandate/token, initial approval, 24-hour pre-debit, recurring charge, webhook, retry and cancellation guide; Collect transition, conflicting rule text and sample faults are qualified in the source.
warnings: Mandate amountRule compares with amount.value in the registration table but with mandate.amount in the later notifyShopper table; do not resolve silently.
Global alphanumeric-only merchant-value rule conflicts with remarks allowing spaces and example references/remarks; examples also contain malformed JSON.
Recurring AUTHORISATION success row repeats mandate-created wording from the initial payment, so interpret its object/action within the recurring section cautiously.
UPI Collect new-integration phaseout, 15,000 INR authentication note, IST windows and 24-hour notice are historical source statements, not current regulatory/merchant eligibility proof.
A successful notifyShopper response, Received recurring payment response, token delete or app return does not itself establish charge or cancellation completion.
